g.text: 24.3 Resume reviewer: one North Star, guardrails as a veto
leading indicators move the North Star; guardrails can stop a launch
North Star: interview callbacks per reviewed
resume within 30 days, compared by cohort
leading indicators: they move first, and can mislead alone
guardrails: a veto, not a trade-off
acceptance up, callbacks flat: the suggestions please but do not help
callbacks up, fabrication up: stop and fix before anything ships
